title: How far is each distance?
prompt: Place each one from the shortest span to the longest.

items.label: A bowling lane
items.fact: A regulation lane is 60 feet from the foul line to the head pin.

items.label: A football field
items.fact: The playing field is 100 yards — about 91 meters — before the end zones.

items.label: A 5K race
items.fact: The 5K is the most popular race distance in the world.

items.label: A marathon
items.fact: The odd 42.195 km was fixed at the 1908 London Olympics to end at the royal box.

items.label: Cleveland to Columbus
items.fact: The I-71 drive is about 230 km, roughly two and a quarter hours.

items.label: Earth to the Moon
items.fact: The average Earth–Moon gap could fit all seven other planets between them.
